# threejsassets licensed asset drop

The game contains procedural fallbacks for every High-priority City, Vice Beach,
and Modular Metropolis asset. Licensed GLBs placed here automatically replace
those fallbacks at runtime.

Expected layout:

```text
assets/vendor/threejsassets/
  city/
    traffic-light-01.glb
    road-gantry-01.glb
    rooftop-units-01.glb
    trash-bin-01.glb
    delivery-van-01.glb
    city-bus-01.glb
  vice-beach/
    cafe-table-chairs.glb
    royal-palm.glb
    coconut-palm.glb
    marina-dock-module.glb
    mooring-piling-cluster.glb
    boardwalk-straight.glb
    shore-straight.glb
    shore-corner-in.glb
    shore-corner-out.glb
  metropolis/
    transformer-kiosk-01.glb
    utility-vent-cabinet-01.glb
    service-gate-01.glb
    road-bus-bay-straight-01.glb
    road-loading-zone-straight-01.glb
```

Do not copy preview models or commit assets without the appropriate
threejsassets commercial license. The source license is documented at
https://threejsassets.com/license.
